}

export interface ScopeValue {
  readonly slot: number;
  readonly kind: string;
}

/** The type of the parameters of Measure. */
export interface MeasureArgs {
  readonly shapes: readonly Shape[];
}

/** The type of the parameters of Hello. */
export interface HelloArgs {
  readonly name: string;
  readonly times: number;
}

/** The type of the parameters of Calc. */
export interface CalcArgs {
  readonly base: number;
}

/** The type of the parameters of Classify. */
export interface ClassifyArgs {
  readonly e: Expr;
}

/** The type of the return of ForEach.Start. */
export interface ForEachStartOut {
  readonly l: readonly number[];
  readonly s: string;
}

/** The type of the parameters of Bar. */
export interface BarArgs {
  readonly a: number;
  readonly b: string;
}

/** The type of the parameters of Resolve. */
export interface ResolveArgs {
  readonly names: readonly string[];
  readonly query: string;
}

/** The type of the return of Resolve.Declare. */
export interface ResolveDeclareOut {
  readonly scope: ReadonlyMap<string, ScopeValue>;
  readonly query: string;
}

/**
 * Maps: a scope of declared names, as a sema pass would keep one. Maps are
 * values: `+` and `-` make new ones. A missing key fails the proc, so
 * lookups are guarded with `in`.
 */
export type Scope = ReadonlyMap<string, ScopeValue>;

export function $enc_Shape(x: $t.Shape): unknown {
  if (x.tag === "Dot") return "Dot";
  if (x.tag === "Circle") return { "Circle": $encFloat(x.value) };
  if (x.tag === "Rect") return { "Rect": $enc_ShapeRect(x.value) };
  return $notA(x, "Shape");
}

export function $dec_Shape(v: unknown, at: string): $t.Shape {
  const [tag, p] = $variant(v, at);
  if (tag === "Dot" && p === $bare) return { tag: "Dot" };
  if (tag === "Circle" && p !== $bare) return { tag: "Circle", value: $decFloat(p, at + ".Circle") };
  if (tag === "Rect" && p !== $bare) return { tag: "Rect", value: $dec_ShapeRect(p, at + ".Rect") };
  return $noVariant(v, at, "Shape");
}

  return {
    "w": $encFloat(x.w),
    "h": $encFloat(x.h),
  };

  };
}
